description: Source code implementing parsing and handling of cryptographic signature algorithms, including OID definitions, ASN.1 parsing, and algorithm selection logic within the 'net' namespace.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the input is empty.

methods.name: IsNull
methods.description: Checks if the input is a NULL ASN.1 value.

methods.name: IsNullOrEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the input is NULL or empty.

methods.name: ParseMaskGenAlgorithm
methods.description: Parses a MaskGenAlgorithm ASN.1 structure, supporting only MGF1.

methods.name: ParseRsaPss
methods.description: Parses RSASSA-PSS parameters ASN.1 structure, supporting specific TLS 1.3 supported configurations.

methods.name: ParseAlgorithmIdentifier
methods.description: Parses an ASN.1 AlgorithmIdentifier, extracting OID and optional parameters.

methods.name: ParseHashAlgorithm
methods.description: Parses a hash algorithm ASN.1 structure, mapping to DigestAlgorithm.

methods.name: ParseSignatureAlgorithm
methods.description: Parses an ASN.1 signature algorithm identifier, returning a SignatureAlgorithm enum.

methods.name: GetTlsServerEndpointDigestAlgorithm
methods.description: Returns the digest algorithm associated with a given signature algorithm, per RFC 5929.
